source: Native AWS through shared signed_requests and DynamoDBProbe transports

Quotas.Description: The maximum number of global secondary indexes that can be created for a table. For more information, see, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/ServiceQuotas.html#limits-secondary-indexes

The maximum number of write throughput allocated for a table or global secondary index. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Limits.html#default-limits-throughput-capacity-modes

Quotas.QuotaName: Write throughput limit for DynamoDB Streams (Provisioned mode)
Quotas.Description: The maximum number of write capacity units allowed for a table with streams enabled; applicable only for tables in provisioned read/write capacity mode. Other quotas might also apply. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/ServiceQuotas.html#limits-dynamodb-streams

The maximum number of write capacity units allocated for the account; applicable only for tables (including all associated global secondary indexes) in provisioned read/write capacity mode. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Limits.html#default-limits-throughput-capacity-modes
The maximum number of tables that can be created per region. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/ServiceQuotas.html#limits-tables

The maximum number of read throughput allocated for a table or global secondary index. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Limits.html#default-limits-throughput-capacity-modes
The maximum number of allowed concurrent control plane operations. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Limits.html#limits-api

The maximum number of read capacity units allocated for the account; applicable only for tables (including all associated global secondary indexes) in provisioned read/write capacity mode. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Limits.html#default-limits-throughput-capacity-modes

A decrease is allowed up to four times any time per day (GMT time zone). Also, if there was no decrease in the past hour, an additional decrease is allowed, effectively bringing the maximum number of decreases in a day to 27 times. For more information, see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/ServiceQuotas.html
